title: Culture Bowl
obtain: Craft a flower pot, Spore Culture and wheat seed into one Bowl; place it on Living Substrate.
use: Use a Synaptic Probe to select, start or cancel a recipe and collect retained slots. Insert ingredients one at a time and water by bucket. Direct stick and empty-hand controls remain available with an empty offhand. An offhand building block can be placed beside the Bowl. Sneak-use a clock for earned incubation growth, or a glass bottle for water economy. Break and replace to move the one saved core and owner.
